name: exact_of_isLocalized_maximal
statement: ∀ (J : Ideal R) [J.IsMaximal], Function.Exact (map J.primeCompl (f J) (g J) F) (map J.primeCompl (g J) (h J) G)) : Function.Exact F G

name: exact_of_isLocalized_span
statement: ∀ r : s, Function.Exact (map (.powers r.1) (f r) (g r) F) (map (.powers r.1) (g r) (h r) G)) : Function.Exact F G

name: injective_of_isLocalization_of_span_eq_top

name: surjective_of_isLocalization_of_span_eq_top
